question: Do the deposited GSE290297 TPM values reproduce the published bulk EGCG and DHEA contrasts, the Th17p-versus-Th17n gene partition and the claim that EGCG raises the pathogenic programme and lowers the Th17n programme in Th17n cells?
decision: Decide whether the paper's Figure 2 transcriptional claims and its EGCG and DHEA signatures survive re-derivation, and freeze the signature definitions that Wp-R1, Wp-R4 and the branch cards consume.
strongest_rival: Apparent agreement arises from shared dominant axes - activation or division-gate composition - rather than treatment-specific programmes, or the published signature depends on a design choice (gate pooling, pairing, gene filter) that the deposit does not record.
discriminator: Gene-level agreement of logFC, moderated t and signature membership against the authors' own Table S3, computed separately per division gate and per analysis variant, plus the logFC distribution of each source-defined gene group within each treatment contrast.
exposure_record: Fully exposed. The paper's Figure 2 conclusions and the authors' Table S3 were read before this contract. Two dry runs of this entrypoint were executed outside the governed runner on 4 October 2026: the first fitted all 20,465 deposited genes without a variance trend and gave a degenerate division-1 partition (1 gene) with prior df near 0.9; the second, after restricting to the authors' Table S3 gene universe and adding a limma-trend prior, gave a 99/79 division-1 partition and t-statistic correlations of 0.85-0.98 with Table S3. The primary specification was fixed on principle (authors' declared universe, standard limma-trend for log-expression without counts) and the first dry-run specification is retained as a reported sensitivity rather than discarded.
biological_unit: Library. GSE290297 declares no animal or culture field, so libraries cannot be grouped into independent animals.
nesting_and_overlap: Five libraries per cell type x treatment x division gate, four for Th17p/DMSO/Div.1. Div.1 and Total are different gated populations of the same cultures and are never pooled or treated as replicates. Whether the five libraries per group are separate mice, separate cultures or split cultures is not recorded. Table S3 is the authors' analysis of these same libraries, so agreement with it is reproduction of one evidence lineage.
population_and_selection: All 79 GSE290297 libraries. Treatment contrasts restricted to the authors' Table S3 gene universe per experiment (EGCG 11,197 and DHEA 10,980 symbols); the DMSO Th17p-versus-Th17n partition uses the EGCG universe because DMSO is that experiment's solvent. No selection on outcome.
contrast: Within cell type and within division gate: EGCG versus DMSO and DHEA versus Methanol. Partition: DMSO Th17p versus DMSO Th17n within each gate. Division-1 is the primary gate because the paper's Figure 2 states division-1 cells; Total is secondary.
endpoint: Per-gene logFC, moderated t and BH-adjusted p; the three-group partition at BH <= 0.05 and |log2 FC| >= 1.5; per-group logFC distributions per treatment contrast; signatures at BH <= 0.05 and |log FC| >= log2(1.5); gene-level agreement with Table S3 (logFC and t correlations, sign agreement, signature recall and Jaccard).
methods: log2(TPM + 1). Two-group moderated t with an empirical-Bayes scaled inverse-chi-square variance prior fitted by matching the moments of log variance (Smyth 2004); the primary variant uses a lowess trend of the prior on average log expression (limma-trend form). Variants: primary_S3universe_trend; sens_S3universe_notrend; sens_unfiltered_notrend. Group distributions tested against zero with a Wilcoxon signed-rank test, BH across all group-contrast cells. Implemented locally with numpy, scipy and statsmodels.
missingness_and_exclusions: No library excluded. Genes absent from the Table S3 universe are excluded from the primary and first sensitivity variants by declaration, and included in the unfiltered sensitivity. Contrasts with fewer than two libraries per arm would be skipped and recorded; none are expected.
multiplicity: BH within each gene-wise contrast; BH across the group-by-contrast distribution tests. No claim depends on an unadjusted per-gene p value.
precision_basis: No animal-level variance is estimable because no animal field exists; library-level standard errors describe these libraries only and are not a precision statement about mice.
interpretation_limit: Library-level descriptive reproduction on deposited TPM. Supports statements about agreement with the source's own analysis and about these libraries; supports no population, animal-level or causal inference, and agreement with Table S3 is not independent replication.
stop_rule: Report every variant and both gates as computed. Do not add variants, change thresholds or switch gates after execution to improve agreement. If a contrast reproduces poorly, report it as such and record candidate explanations as unverified.
amendment_reason: Initial prospective execution version for Wp-R3. Exposure is full and both pre-freeze dry runs are recorded in the exposure record.
